name: day precision on a DST day: claimedAtEnd keeps the 25th hour in the window
notes: US clocks fall back on Sun 2026-11-01 (a 25-hour local day) and spring forward on Sun 2026-03-08 (a 23-hour local day). The adapter reads 'Sunday' as day precision with claimedAt = the local midnight that starts the day and claimedAtEnd = the next local midnight (§4.1 v1.2, computed with the injected offset function).

o1 at 2026-11-01T23:50-08:00 (11-02 07:50Z), the 25th hour: inside [start, end] → Δ = 0 → tp 1; same address → ce 1, cd 1; same subject → so 1. S = 9000/9000 = 1/1 → verified. With end = start + 24 h (11-02 07:00Z) the window would end at 07:45Z and o1 would not even be a candidate (a false NOT_FOUND).
c1 FINAL (§8 VERIFIED): the November entry synced 11-02 10:00Z ≥ end + graceMin = 08:30Z.

c2: S = (2500·15/44 + 3500 + 1500 + 1500)/9000 = (37 500 + 286 000)/(44·9000) = 323 500/396 000 = 647/792 (≈ 0.8169): ≥ 1/2, < 17/20 → partial. With end = start + 24 h (08:00Z) o2 would sit inside the unit and wrongly verify a claim about the previous day.
c2 FINAL (§8 PARTIAL, graceElapsed): an eligible gmail.sent entry synced ≥ end + 30 and ≥ end + 45 = 03-09 07:45Z (the March entry, 09:00Z; the November one too).
The two claims are eight months apart, so neither observation is in the other claim's window. No activity → no orphan receipts.
